## What and why

## Definition of done (self-review)

- [ ] Builds; `spotlessCheck detekt lint test` all pass locally
- [ ] Previews or screenshot tests for new UI
- [ ] Respects reduced motion and has TalkBack labels; all strings in resources
- [ ] Stays within the performance and quota budgets (`docs/QUOTA_BUDGET.md`)
- [ ] No secrets, no emojis, no placeholder or fake data in release paths
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased section updated
- [ ] Decision recorded in `docs/DECISIONS.md` if one was made
